title: میز کارگاه، قبل و بعد
logline_fa: میز کارگاه شلوغ و بی‌نظم است؛ خطی وسط صفحه کنار می‌رود و ابزارها، که هر کدام شخصیتی دارند، خودشان را می‌چینند: یک سو آشوب، سوی دیگر نظم.
ratio_note: 16:9 designed as a left/right split, 9:16 re-design as a top/bottom split

protagonist.what: a hammer, a screwdriver and a tape measure, equal peers with dot eyes
protagonist.build: 3 SVG tools with two dot eyes; each hops to its slot with different timing (anticipation, overshoot); a divider line slides between the halves
protagonist.state_change: messy pile on one half -> each tool in its slot on the other half

beats.what: two tables: one clean outline, one messy
divider slides; tools hop one by one to the tidy side
tidy side full, messy side empty

payoffs.viewer_gets: first tool hops with surprise eyes
tape measure unrolls past the slot and snaps back
all tools click into place at once
soft light on the tidy side, copy appears

assets: SVG table, hammer, screwdriver, tape, divider, clutter shapes
kit sfx: wood tick, boing, spring, click, bell

tests: three equal peers with individual timing
likely_skill_gaps: no gate for equal peer sizing
acceptance: peer sizes within 10% of each other (hero-size gate)
pacing: three hops on the beat grid +-1 frame
